newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wiseway offer for Allied Ind completed.
newsitem.headline: Wiseway offer for Allied Ind completed.

text.p: Allied Industries International Ltd and Wiseway Enterprises Ltd said on Tuesday Wiseway received valid acceptances of 133,300 shares in its general offer for the property, building materials and manufacturing company.
Indonesian-based investment group Wiseway offered HK$0.85 per share for all outstanding Allied issued shares and HK$0.01 for every 100 options, the companies said in a joint statement.

After the offer closed on Monday, Wiseway and parties acting in concert had a total beneficial holding of 410.50 million shares, representing about 50.6 percent of Allied's existing issued share capital, they said.
At least 25 percent of Allied's issued share capital was held by the public, they said.

Wiseway was required to make an unconditional cash offer for Allied shares after it bought a 50.59 percent stake or 410.36 million shares in the company from Allied Group Ltd and Allied Properties (H.K.) Ltd in December.
As stated in the offer document, Wiseway director Suryadi Tanuwidjaja was appointed chairman of Allied Industries, the statement said.
Allied Industries shares were up HK$0.03 at HK$1.60 in mid-morning trade on Tuesday.
